name: data-kb scale and degradation stress plan
purpose: Measure whether retrieval quality, latency, and token overhead degrade as the memory corpus grows.

failure_interpretation.quality_drops_with_size: Ranking or namespace filtering is not robust enough.
failure_interpretation.latency_explodes: Indexing, database query plan, cache, or two-stage retrieval needs improvement.
failure_interpretation.forbidden_hits_increase: Scope/status filters are being applied too late or only after ranking.
failure_interpretation.token_overhead_grows: Retrieved context needs compression, top-k tuning, or better reranking.
